name: IOF 2.0
description: The IOF brand as light: translucent plates tinted from IOF Blue with the brand pattern (green, blue and white glows) drifting inside, a band of light on entry, the red-over-green LINES as hairlines, the runner in focus on a bright band, Franklin Gothic Heavy numerals, the white IOF logo. A timing tower for results and start lists and a scorebug clock top left.
author: Split Control, after the IOF broadcast graphics guidelines
fonts: Libre Franklin (OFL) stands in for Franklin Gothic Heavy and Book
